<math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>

solution.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> in presence of aqueous solution precipitates sulphide of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> (IInd group) apart from <math><mtext>P</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>b</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>B</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>i</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>C</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>d</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>A</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>s</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>S</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>b</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> and <math><mtext>S</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>n</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mtext>M</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>n</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>N</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>i</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>  are of IVth  group so cannot be precipitated by <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> .
